title: Unallocated integrity rows need signed source and scope reconciliation
remediation: The sponsor assessment authority reconciles each displayed identifier and edition against the ITSP.10.171 source, which marks these rows not allocated and withdrawn by NIST. Record a source-cited signed scope disposition per identifier, including any replacement objective reference supplied by the competent authority. Keep these paths open pending the reviewed determination.

milestones.title: Collect a signed sponsor assessment decision that reconciles each identifier to the authoritative edition and records the scope disposition
